name: agenttool-collab
description: Local coordination, bounded event waiting and optional read-only witness status

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate agent sessions with local evidence.
interface.longDescription: Collab 0.5.0: 33 tools over one local plaintext SQLite journal, with separate self-declared presence and credential-bound coordination. Adds bounded read-only anchored event waiting without acknowledgement, last_seen/presence writes or lease renewal; continue from next_anchor, never the head. Includes reports, advisory claims, review, refusable handoffs and optional local Zerone witness status. It never contacts a chain or creates an anchor. One MCP process has one session binding; independent children need separate endpoints. MCP results remain provider-visible. Native dispatcher, persona, memory, permissions, lifecycle and idle wake remain host-owned; arrival is not proof of reading or consent.
defaultPrompt: Start credential-bound coordination for these sessions.
List optional self-declared presence without treating it as identity.
Reconcile reports and review completed edit tasks.
Check optional local witness status without contacting a chain.
